upBlockFirstPara: UpBlock breaks up incoming wave energy before it ever reaches the shoreline, cutting down erosion and storm flooding. Turn up the swell and watch it go to work — its winding, mangrove-root silhouette is shaped specifically to knock waves down right at the surface.
upBlockSecondPara: UpBlock doesn't just calm the water — its rough, porous surface gives marine life somewhere to settle and take hold. Move your cursor over it and watch the reef come alive.
interestPointOne: Individual UpBlock units link together into full-scale barriers sized for the site they're protecting. Every layout is engineered around local wave conditions, so fewer modules deliver stronger, longer-lasting protection.
interestPointTwo: Each module is 3D-printed at full scale from a mortar mix that swaps out sand for crushed, recycled oyster shell — the first material of its kind. It holds up in salt water and gives marine organisms a surface they actually want to colonize.
interestPointThree: The module's porous texture and shell-based material make it an easy foothold for the smallest reef organisms first, and over time it grows into genuine shelter for a wide range of marine species. That growth isn't just cosmetic — the more life that settles on an UpBlock, the better it gets at breaking up waves.
